notes.title: Important Notes
notes.optional: All parameters are optional. However, when enabling auto-redirect, the target server name is required.
notes.compatibility: Not all parameters are supported by all posting destinations. Some parameters may be ignored depending on the platform.
notes.mastodonExample: Example: Hashtags parameter is ignored on Mastodon. Therefore, if you watn to include hashtags, it should be included to the post content parameter.
notes.visibility: Visibility settings are only supported by Mastodon and Misskey. Mastodon supports public/unlisted/private/direct, while Misskey supports public/home/followers/specified.

dataCollection.title: Data Collection
